system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: We provide the following input format to the Agent, consisting of the system prompt, execution history, the current observation as a DOM representation, and the user query containing the goal.
system_prompt_style.note: Paper only; no mechanism for prompt construction described.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Subsequent observations consist of web pages from the browser, represented as a HTML DOM format.
env_context_strategy.note: Web domain: agent navigates via browser actions; no repository context.

context_compaction.note: Paper describes compact history h_t=(a1..a_{t-1},o_t) dropping past observations (closest to tool_output_pruning), but no code/config surface available.

observation_format.evidence_quote: we design an intermediate state representation that crawls the raw HTML content of a website to retrieve relevant visual components, and highlight interactive elements to the model.
observation_format.note: DOM representation coded as a11y_tree; screenshots are used only by the GPT-4-V evaluator.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: The agent is allowed the actions, "CLICK [ID]", "GOTO [URL]", "TYPE [ID] [TEXT]", "SUBMIT [ID]", "CLEAR [ID]", "SCROLL [UP/DOWN]", and "ASK USER HELP".
tool_call_format.note: Text commands in model output; no enum value for DSL command strings, closest cli_flags. Parser not available.

tool_count.evidence_quote: The agent is allowed the actions, "CLICK [ID]", "GOTO [URL]", "TYPE [ID] [TEXT]", "SUBMIT [ID]", "CLEAR [ID]", "SCROLL [UP/DOWN]", and "ASK USER HELP".
tool_count.note: OpenTable action set counted as distinct actions; not tool schemas.

edit_primitive.note: Web agent; no code/tool registry available to confirm absence of file editing.

protocol_standardization.note: No code or dependency list available.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Our base approach is a ReAct agent Yao et al. (2023b) with a preliminary planning step (PlanReAct)
loop_primitives.note: MCTS test-time search (Sec. 5.1) adds tree_search; zero-shot Agent Q runs PlanReAct only.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: prompt the agent to generate a planaplan
planning_granularity.note: Plan generated in language as part of first action; not a stored structured object.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: The critic, also initialized as the same base LLM model used by the policy, ranks the actions proposed by the policy.
multi_agent_topology.note: Policy plus critic model; reviewer model still single per rule.

delegation_mechanism.note: No code; paper does not describe delegation.

human_in_loop.note: Agent can 'ASK USER HELP' (Sec. 6.1) for clarification, not gating; no config surface.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: the agent history consists of the actions generated so far and the current browser state.

long_term_memory.note: Replay buffer is for training, not runtime memory; no code.

self_verification.evidence_quote: We use the base model to produce a feedback score for each action by asking it to rank the generated actions by its perceived utility in helping the agent complete the user task.
self_verification.note: GPT-4-V outcome evaluator (Fig. 5) is llm_judge; both apply in MCTS/training mode.

retry_policy.note: MCTS rollouts are search, not task retries; no code.

rollback.note: Paper notes search 'requires ... the capability to rollback actions' but no mechanism described.

termination_condition.note: Output includes a status code (Fig. 2) and MCTS depth T; no loop code.

execution_isolation.note: Browser environment on live websites; boundary not described.

network_policy.note: Operates on live OpenTable site, implying egress, but no policy config available.

tracing.note: Trajectories stored in replay buffer for training; tracing facility not described.

eval_hooks.note: No repo; evaluated on WebShop/OpenTable in paper.

guardrails.note: Paper Sec. 7 says additional safety critics might be required.

target_domain.evidence_quote: In this work we explore improving planning and reasoning capabilities of a web agent, which interacts with a real world website.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: We utilize LLaMa 3-70B as the base model in our experiments.
model_agnostic.note: xLAM and LLaMA used as policies; no client abstraction shown.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: Agent Q: Advanced Reasoning and Learning for Autonomous AI Agents
